hints.title: Minimum Path Sum Invariant
hints.text: For any root, the minimum price sum path starting at root is simply the root node itself.

hints.title: Equivalent Leaf-to-Leaf Problem
hints.text: The cost of choosing root r is (max path from r to a leaf) - price[r], which is the path sum excluding root.

hints.title: Subtree Dual Extremes
hints.text: Compute two values per node: max path to a leaf including the leaf, and max path to a leaf excluding the leaf.

hints.title: Tree Dynamic Programming Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def maxOutput(self, n: int, edges: list[list[int]], price: list[int]) -> int:
        adj = [[] for _ in range(n)]
        for u, v in edges:
            adj[u].append(v)
            adj[v].append(u)
        
        ans = 0
        def dfs(u: int, p: int):
            nonlocal ans
            max_with = price[u]
            max_without = 0
            for v in adj[u]:
                if v == p:
                    continue
                cw, cwo = dfs(v, u)
                ans = max(ans, max_with + cwo, max_without + cw)
                max_with = max(max_with, price[u] + cw)
                max_without = max(max_without, price[u] + cwo)
            return max_with, max_without

        dfs(0, -1)
        return ans
```

variables: n: number of nodes in tree
complexity.notes: Single post-order tree traversal propagating path sums with and without leaf endpoints.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Running a full search from each candidate root takes O(n^2).
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) auxiliary space for recursion and adjacency tree.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Applies tree post-order DP tracking leaf inclusion states to solve root difference in linear time.
